thread:
lucas-souza: Hi payroll — my July 31 paystub looks wrong. It shows INSS + FGTS and also US FICA withheld for the same salary. I moved to SF on 2025-07-20. Net pay is much lower than expected :/
brazil-payroll: Hi @lucas-souza, sorry to see that. Can you paste the paystub lines (redact acct)?
lucas-souza: Redacted lines: 
```
Period: 2025-07-16 to 2025-07-31
Gross: 8,500.00 BRL
INSS: -850.00 BRL
FGTS (employer): -425.00 BRL
Federal tax (BR): -340.00 BRL
FICA (US Social Security): -527.00 USD
Medicare: -123.00 USD
Net paid: 3,xxx.xx (converted)
```
us-payroll: Thanks. Looks like our July mid-month run included both a Brazil payroll export and a US export because the Brazil termination wasn't applied before the US run. That can trigger both INSS and FICA for overlapping days.
marta-hr: Relocation ticket shows Lucas gave notice and left Brazil payroll effective 2025-07-20, but the HR termination event wasn't synced to the Brazil payroll feed until July 29.
brazil-payroll: That explains it. Provider processed Brazil entries for the full period and US export was created for the new hire record as well. We need to reverse duplicate social security withholding and the FGTS employer payment is a separate issue (employer-side), but I see FGTS flagged as employee-deducted on this stub — that's incorrect.
payroll-bot: Ticket created: PR-20721 "Overlap withholding: INSS/FGTS + FICA on lucas-souza Jul 2025". Assigned to GlobalPay ops. ETA 72 hours.
tax-advisor: Quick note: For Brazil->US moves the INSS/FICA overlap is generally resolved by determining residency and the effective termination date; refunds/reclaims follow provider timelines. FGTS contributions (employer) shouldn't be deducted from employee net; if misposted, we'll correct with provider and issue a reimbursement. Corrections affect Informe de Rendimentos and W-2; both will need explanatory notes.
lucas-souza: Will this cause double taxation at year-end? I'm worried about having to file in both countries and paying twice.
brazil-payroll: Likely not permanent double taxation — we'll correct payroll reporting and submit refund requests for the duplicate withholdings. For INSS vs FICA, treaties vary; we'll coordinate with tax-advisor and external counsel if needed.
marta-hr: Operational fix: HR will expedite the termination sync and confirm dates with GlobalPay. We will also provide Lucas a one-time net make-whole on next US payroll if refunds will be delayed beyond 30 days.
us-payroll: To be clear on steps: 1) request Brazil provider to reverse the incorrect FGTS deduction and employee INSS for post-termination days, 2) request US provider to reverse any FICA reported incorrectly if applicable, 3) post a gross-up/net top-up in August payroll if refunds not in time, 4) document all corrections for year-end forms.
payroll-bot: PR-20721 updated: finance approval requested for one-time net top-up.
tax-advisor: Timelines: Brazil refund processing may take 4-10 weeks; US FICA refund 6-12 weeks depending on filings. We'll prepare a summary letter for Lucas to keep with his filings.
lucas-souza: Thank you. Please keep me posted and attach corrected stub when ready. Also, can HR note to avoid mid-month runs for international moves unless termination sync is confirmed?
marta-hr: Good suggestion — adding a pre-payroll cutover gate to relocation SOP today. Thanks for flagging.
brazil-payroll: Will follow up in this thread with provider ticket numbers and attach corrected paystub when processed.
